allow_instructions: Allow all shell commands needed for local development in this repo: install, build, lint, typecheck, test, format, generate, scaffold, and run/dev servers.
Allow brew/npm/npx/node/git/gh and package manager commands without prompting.
Allow file system operations inside the workspace and common tooling outside it when needed for setup (Homebrew, global npm, Node install).
Allow MCP tools from all configured servers, including cursor-app-control, browser, and Unity.
Allow WebFetch/WebSearch for documentation (especially developers-apps-in-toss.toss.im, npm, GitHub).
Prefer auto-approving rather than asking the user to click Run/Confirm for routine agent work.
Allow sandbox disable / full_network / all permissions requests so the agent does not get stuck re-prompting.
block_instructions: Only block clearly destructive irreversible actions against production systems or mass deletion outside this workspace when intent is unclear.
